98: Babe is a little pig who doesn't quite know his place in the world. With a bunch of odd friends, like Ferdinand the duck who thinks he is a rooster and Fly the dog he calls mum, Babe realises that he has the makings to become the greatest sheep pig of all time, and Farmer Hoggett knows it. With the help of the sheep dogs, Babe learns that a pig can be anything that he wants to be.
A little pig goes a long way.
354: In turn of the century London, a magical nanny employs music and adventure to help two neglected children become closer to their father.
The fairest of them all...the funniest of them all!
610: Trevor, an insomniac lathe operator, experiences unusual occurrences at work and home. A strange man follows him everywhere, but no one else seems to notice him.
How do you wake up from a nightmare if you’re not asleep?
866: A supermarket clerk decides to step in for an absent drug dealer, setting off an explosive, comedic chain of events.
1122: Alex Kerner's mother was in a coma while the Berlin wall fell. When she wakes up he must try to keep her from learning what happened (as she was an avid communist supporter) to avoid shocking her which could lead to another heart attack.

CIA agent Napoleon Solo and KGB agent Illya Kuryakin are forced to put aside their hostilities and work together to stop the evildoers in their tracks. Saving the world never goes out of style.
1634: In the midst of a nasty public breakup of married movie stars, a studio publicist scrambles to put a cap on the escalating situation as the couple's latest film has found it's only print kidnapped by the director.
Hollywood's hottest couple just split up. It'll take more than special effects to reunite them.
1890: Welcome to Hotel Transylvania, Dracula's lavish five-stake resort, where monsters and their families can live it up and no humans are allowed. For Dracula catering to all of these legendary monsters is no problem but the party really starts when one ordinary guy stumbles into the hotel and changes everything!
Where monsters go to get away from it all.
2146: In 19th century France, Jean Valjean, a man imprisoned for stealing bread, must flee a relentless policeman named Javert. The pursuit consumes both men's lives, and soon Valjean finds himself in the midst of the student revolutions in France.
2402: A writer stumbles upon a long-hidden secret when he agrees to help former British Prime Minister Adam Lang complete his memoirs on a remote island after the politician's assistant drowns in a mysterious accident.
2658: Ella lives in a magical world in which each child, at the moment of their birth, is given a virtuous "gift" from a fairy godmother. Ella's so-called gift, however, is obedience. 2914: The Marx Brothers take on high society and the opera world to bring two lovers together. A sly business manager and two wacky friends of two opera singers help them achieve success while humiliating their stuffy and snobbish enemies.
Don't miss it! The funniest picture ever made!
3170: After being released from a mental hospital, a troubled young man tracks down an actress he once had sex with and forces her into captivity, determined to make her part of his life.
A love story... with strings attached!
3426: As the gang return to Jumanji to rescue one of their own, they discover that nothing is as they expect. The players will have to brave parts unknown and unexplored in order to escape the world’s most dangerous game.
New places. New faces. Next level.
3682: A horrifying premonition saves a young man and his friends from death during a racetrack accident but terrible fates await them nonetheless.
3938: A young boy whose parents just divorced finds an unlikely friend and mentor in the misanthropic, bawdy, hedonistic, war veteran who lives next door.
With neighbors like these, who needs family?
4194: An orphan bear cub hooks up with an adult male as they try to dodge human hunters.
He's an orphan... at the start of a journey. A journey to survive.
4450: The tale of an ordinary garden snail who dreams of winning the Indy 500.
4706: Set in the near future, Lockout follows a falsely convicted ex-government agent , whose one chance at obtaining freedom lies in the dangerous mission of rescuing the President's daughter from rioting convicts at an outer space maximum security prison.
4962: Set in the 1920s French Riviera, a master magician is commissioned to try and expose a psychic as a fraud.
5218: In 1979 Santa Barbara, California, Dorothea Fields is a determined single mother in her mid-50s who is raising her adolescent son, Jamie, at a moment brimming with cultural change and rebellion. 5474: Kim Sun-woo is an enforcer and manager for a hotel owned by a cold, calculative crime boss, Kang who assigns Sun-woo to a simple errand while he is away on a business trip; to shadow his young mistress, Hee-soo, for fear that she may be cheating on him with a younger man with the mandate that he must kill them both if he discovers their affair.

A hero who doesn't exist must save America from an enemy we never knew we had.
5986: The enthusiastic Pirate Captain, along with his rag-tag crew, sets out to beat his bitter rivals. The chaotic adventure takes them from exotic shores to Victorian London, and from a haplessly smitten scientist to a diabolical queen.
6242: In 200,000 years of existence, man has upset the balance on which the Earth had lived for 4 billion years. Global warming, resource depletion, species extinction: man has endangered his own home. A stunning visual portrayal of Earth
6498: Set in 50 B.C., Asterix and Obelix are living in a small but well-protected village in Gaul, where a magic potion concocted by Druids turns the townsfolk into mighty soldiers. Self - Former Chief, Houston Fire Department

Who knew so many little people would throw such a huge party?

Gloria. Big mouth. Big attitude. But who knew she had a big heart.

Some People Tell Lies. Others Live Them.

Lets Make This The Most Memorable Road Trip Ever

When they reach out for each other... they touch every heart... with warmth, charm and laughter!
8546: After watching their respective partners die, a cop and a hitman form an alliance in order to bring down their common enemy.

You really thought you’ve been scared?
10082: Hollywood comedian/actor Pauly Shore loses everything: his house, nobody in Hollywood wants to represent him, he moves back home with his mom and is now parking cars at the Comedy Store. Pauly then fakes his own death, and the media goes crazy.
Hollywood Will Never Be the Same
10338: An archaeological team attempt to unlock the secrets of a lost pyramid only to find themselves hunted by an insidious creature.
10594: After deciding he needs to do something meaningful with his life, high school wrestler Louden Swain sets out on a mission to drop weight and challenge the area's undefeated champion, which creates problems with his teammates and health. All he needed was a lucky break. Then one day she moved in.

Follow your heart. Discover your soul.

Duke, Chester, the thugs, Ace and his henchman chase each other all over the countryside—for the map.
11618: Supernatural private eye, Dylan Dog, seeks out the monsters of the Louisiana bayou in his signature red shirt, black jacket and blue jeans.
12130: A family falls prey to the manipulative charms of a neighbor, who abducts their adolescent daughter. Twice.
12386: The trial story of Viviane Amsalem's five year fight to obtain her divorce in front of the only legal authority competent for divorce cases in Israel, the Rabbinical Court.
12642: In a post-apocalyptic world, a warrior wandering through the desert comes upon a group of settlers who are being menaced by a murderous gang that is after the water they control.
He is the desert warrior, carving the future with his sword.
12898: In 17th century France, young D'Artagnan wants to join the King's Musketeers, but instead befriends three legendary musketeers—Athos, Porthos, and Aramis—and together, they become embroiled in the political intrigue surrounding King Louis XIII and his adversaries, particularly the powerful Cardinal Richelieu.
13154: A reporter is murdered while driving to his job. The Police are contacted by a clairvoyant who saw the death in a vision, but some dark force is preventing him from seeing the man behind the crime...
Dr. Mabuse is on the loose!
Prof. Jordan / Peter Cornelius / Dr. Mabuse

Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher, but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence.
13666: During the Cultural Revolution, two young men are sent to a remote mining village where they fall in love with the local tailor's beautiful granddaughter and discover a suitcase full of forbidden Western novels.
13922: Nick Cochran, an American in exile in Macao, has a chance to restore his name by helping capture an international crime lord. Undercover, can he mislead the bad guys and still woo the attractive singer/petty crook, Julie Benson?
A sultry chanteuse, a hunk on the lam and a fortune in stolen gems

What A Cast!... What A Past!... What A Show!...

Every house has a history. This one has a legend.

God wanted a fighter… and He found one.

To his parents' horror, he gets a normal job.
For anyone who ever felt different... your hero has arrived.

A grave's dank darkness smothers the screams of a girl still alive!

There are no good guys in this story.

You're never home alone when you're a twin!
16738: In San Francisco, a psychopathic gangster and his mentor retrieve heroin packages carried by unsuspecting travelers.
The Manhunt They Had to Put On the Giant-Sized Movie Theater Screen!
16994: Before eleven years old Tilda's parents can put her beloved grandfather in an old people's home due to his progressing Alzheimer disease, she takes him on one last adventure that subliminally threatens to tear her family apart.

The streets - your only chance for life.

Nobody in chains, ever soared up to the sun.

Only MacKintosh can save them now - and MacKintosh is dead!

19042: When crooks set up operations in a traditional town, a minister and a group of church ladies are willing to do anything, no matter how wacky, to get them out.
The FBI couldn't do it... the CIA couldn't do it... so they sent for... Hill's Angels.

19810: A Seattle couple travel to New York to interview colorful former dancer Tobi for research on a dissertation about dance. But soon, common niceties and social graces erode when the questions turn personal and the true nature of the interview is called into question.

As in his previous films, this Kurdish director is again focusing on the oppression of his people.

Plunged into an ancient custom they cannot comprehend, the couple must find a way to survive the night of the Seventh Moon.
20834: The survivors of a plane crash in a remote area are attacked by blob-like alien creatures that turn their victims into blood-thirsty vampires.
A fiendish vampire from a strange world in outer space drains his victims' blood and turns them into weird corpses!

Where does a woman's sympathy leave off -- and her indiscretion begin?
21858: Swedish account of Raoul Wallenberg, the man responsible for the largest rescue of Jews during World War II.
22114: Max Andreev thought the best place to start a new life would be at the other end of the world. What he didn't know, is that you can't outrun your past.
He must face a diffucult choice.
22370: Two brothers need household help after their Ma passes away. They decide to join a romance tour to Russia to find and bring home a traditionally minded wife.
They're not looking for love, they're looking for a wife!
22626: A man's simple lie to secure his job escalates into more complex lies when his orthodox boss becomes suspicious.
Ram Prasad Dasharath Prasad Sharma / Laxman Prasad Dasharath Prasad Sharma
22882: When two bumbling barbers act as agents for a talented but unknown singer, they stage a phony murder in order to get him a plum role.

All seems hopelessly bleak, yet when Hamo begins to court Nina, their unexpected love revitalizes them.
23394: After a fateful miss, an assassin battles his employers, and himself, on an international manhunt he insists isn't personal.
23650: Kabir and his family's fun weekend retreat takes terrifying turn when an intruder takes over the control of the  body of his teenage daughter, putting her at the mercy of his increasingly sinister orders.

24162: Arun and Darshana are first-year engineering students and they fall in love soon after their college begins. And just as how things work generally in teenage, the road ahead isn't too easy for them. Life offers many twists and turns that they least expect.
24418: A spoof on many horror movie series. Ending his shift at the video rental, Stan's picked up by his BFF and 2 cute girls, all going to a Halloween party. Will they even get there?
The most feared monsters in cinematic history have met their match...
24674: A once-great basketball coach is on a journey back to victory by reuniting his former high school championship basketball team, but this time, he’s challenging them to play like girls.
Winners are just losers who win.
24930: An heiress who's been shut inside her apartment building for nearly two decades is forced to confront her fears after one of her neighbors is killed and a detective arrives to begin the investigation.
25186: Kelogan fights the black prince to serve justice.

When Time gives you Second Chance

The father does not want to have a disabled child, but the mother insists on going through with the pregnancy.

You can't keep out what's already inside.

Valérie quickly recovers, but forbids her mother from seeing her grandson anymore. Feeling lonely and guilty, Michelle falls into a depression... until Marie-Claude's son gets out of prison.

Experience the Holiday Classic as You've Never Seen it Before
28002: With dazzling nature photography, Academy Award®–nominated director Markus Imhoof (The Boat Is Full) takes a global examination of endangered honeybees — spanning California, Switzerland, China and Australia — more ambitious than any previous work on the topic.
Einstein once said, If bees die out, mankind will follow 4 years later
28258: On July 19–21, 2001, over 200,000 people took to the streets of Genoa to protest against the ongoing G8 summit. 28514: Jacob is a young man used to getting everything he wants. For several years, he has been living in a happy homosexual partnership with Jørgen, and one night Jacob decides to pop the big question to Jørgen. Jørgen happily accepts Jacobs marriage proposal, but then something happens: Jacob falls in love with a girl, and not just any girl. The girl is Caroline, married to Jørgens younger brother Tom.
28770: A drama about a young man aspiring to become a singer and a washed-up former hit producer. The two men head off on a road trip filled with music and jamming sessions.
A miracle music buster that will satisfy your five senses.

31586: Christopher Columbus believes he can find an alternative route to the far East and persuades the King and Queen of Spain to finance his expedition...
31842: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.
Young Ye Shurou / Young Iap Sogriu
